LanguageData.UNCrime_UltimatumTerms: At least 100 crime penalty points within ten days. Select your leader in UN Central and surrender them alive by UN shuttle within three days (+20 UN goodwill). The deadline runs even without selection. Expiry: −20 and a targeted arrest intervention.
LanguageData.UNCrime_Rules: Additional convention rules: neutral aggression −50, allied/peaceful settlement −75, UN aid workers −50; civilian killing −30, execution/incapacitated opponent −25; toxic weapons −30. Organ harvest −20, mutilation −15, abuse −5, forced recruitment −5, enslavement −15, unauthorized UN equipment −10. Prisoner experiments −20 (configured actions); proven fatal starvation −30. Only reliably attributed events count. Environmental assessment every 3 days: own fraction >0 to <25% −10, 25 to <75% −20, 75%+ −50; every 5 dumped packs −1, each newly polluted own weapon cell −1. Ultimatum after 100 crime points in 10 days; 3-day surrender deadline, +20 success/−20 expiry. Missing or unreliable mod events are not automatically covered.
